description: This PHP class defines a plugin for the Revive Adserver that manages delivery rules based on registerable domain lists, supporting whitelist/blacklist filtering with UI components and domain sanitization.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Site_Registerabledomainlist
classes.description: A plugin class for managing delivery rules based on registerable domain whitelists or blacklists, with UI rendering and data processing methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with specific operations for whitelist and blacklist, and sets the display name.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Displays the UI for the delivery rule, depending on whether the PHP intl extension is loaded.

methods.name: _displayMainUI
methods.description: Renders the main UI for editing registerable domain lists with textareas and buttons.

methods.name: _displayIntlMissingWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning message if the PHP intl extension is missing.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Transforms user input data into a regex pattern for domain matching, converting domains to puny-code, anchoring with \\z, and joining with |.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the data into a delivery rule pattern using the _preCompile method.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns sanitized registerable domain data, formatted as a newline-separated string.

methods.name: _sanitiseData
methods.description: Processes input lines to extract, deduplicate, and sort registerable domains, ignoring invalid URLs.
